Package frc.robot.autos

Class AutoManager

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.autos.AutoManager
public class AutoManager extends Object
Manages autonomous routines using Choreo trajectory following.

This class integrates with the Choreo library to create and execute autonomous routines with precise trajectory following. It handles:

  • Loading pre-generated trajectories from the deploy directory
  • Following trajectories with PID-based feedback control
  • Alliance-aware coordinate transformation for symmetric routines
  • Dashboard visualization of active trajectories

The manager uses three independent PID controllers (X, Y, rotation) to correct deviations from the desired trajectory path. Trajectories are automatically flipped based on alliance color to support symmetric autonomous routines.

  • Constructor Details

    • AutoManager

      public AutoManager(Drivetrain drivetrain)
      Constructs an AutoManager with trajectory loading and factory setup.

      This constructor:

      • Initializes the Choreo AutoFactory with trajectory following callbacks
      • Loads all .traj files from the deploy/choreo directory
      • Configures continuous input for the rotation controller (wrapping at ±π)
      • Sets up dashboard visualization for the active trajectory

      The factory is configured to automatically flip trajectories based on alliance color and visualize them on the field widget.

      Parameters:
      drivetrain - The drivetrain subsystem for trajectory following

  • Method Details

    • follow

      public void follow(choreo.trajectory.SwerveSample sample)
      Follows a single trajectory sample with PID correction.

      Called by the Choreo library for each sample point in the trajectory. Combines feedforward velocities from the trajectory with PID feedback corrections based on the current pose error.

      The resulting chassis speeds are sent to the drivetrain in field-relative mode with a fixed origin (blue alliance perspective).

      Parameters:
      sample - The desired trajectory sample containing pose and velocities

    • routine

      public choreo.auto.AutoRoutine routine()
      Creates a new autonomous routine.

      Currently returns an empty routine skeleton. Trajectories and commands should be added to this routine to define the autonomous behavior.

      Returns:
      A new AutoRoutine for autonomous execution
